testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/shopping-cart/verify-percent-off-category-coupon-functionality.spec.ts > Webstore - Shopping Cart > verify percent off category coupon functionality

scenario.summary: A registered user (the selected profile) checks a Percent Off Category coupon: rejected for a product outside the category and below the minimum, applied when two eligible products are raised to quantity 13 (percent of subtotal). As a guest (non-selected profile) the coupon is rejected. No order.
steps: Sign in as the registered user, empty the cart and remove any coupon
Add the other-category product (sku1) at qty 1, apply couponCode: Invalid coupon code, no discount; remove coupon, empty cart
Add the two eligible products (sku2, sku3) at qty 1, apply couponCode: Invalid coupon code, no discount
Raise both lines (found by name2, name3) to updatedQuantity: success message, coupon row, discount label
Check unit costs > 0, discount = discountAmount% x subtotal, order total = subtotal - discount
Empty the cart, log out; as guest add both eligible products at updatedQuantity and apply couponCode: not applied, Invalid coupon code
stateChanges: Coupon is created per run through the API (consumable COUPON_* key); the test only applies and removes it, no order is placed, so one redemption is enough
Registered user's cart and guest cart: products added, coupon applied/removed, emptied at cleanup
assertions: Other-category product: invalid message "- " + invalidCouponMessage, coupon row shows couponCode, no discount
Below minimum: invalid message, coupon row shows couponCode, no discount
Both lines at updatedQuantity; success message "- " + promoAppliedSuccesssMessage; coupon row shows couponCode; discount label visible
Unit costs > 0; discount close to subtotal x discountAmount/100; order total close to subtotal - discount
Guest: no success message, invalid message and coupon row shown
Empty cart message visible after cleanup
evidence: Title: 'verify percent off category coupon functionality'
Spec note: CATEGORY30 is a 30% category coupon profile-restricted to the signed-in user's profile; the non-selected-profile check runs as guest

Profile: CATEGORY30 is a Percent Off Category coupon on MaxwellsHardware, discount 30.0, orderMinimum 300; today the minimum is an order amount, the key models it as minimumQuantity <= quantityUsed (13)
Profile: sku1 z-4567890, sku2 z-2100018, sku3 z-2100022 are active in-stock simple products
Discount assertions use the resolved coupon's discountAmount (role data), not the literal 30.00
allProfiles false, profile Retail Customer (the signed-in user's profile); the guest (Anonymous) must not get it
Links: the coupon is created on product1's category (categoryId @product1.categoryId); product2 is in the same category (inCategoryId), otherProduct outside it (notInCategoryId)
orderMinimum left out: the minimum the test crosses is modelled as minimumQuantity <= quantityUsed (13)

User decision 2026-10-29 (C2b): notDiscountedForProfile Retail Customer on all three products: the coupon is applied and the percent discount asserted signed in; the guest step only asserts the coupon is rejected

User decision 2026-10-29 (C2d): signed-in cart (Retail order minimum 650, PromoPercentOffOrder): product1 + product2 at qty 13 each -> 13 x (p1 + p2) < 650 -> each price < 650 / 26 = 25 -> maxPrice 25; otherProduct alone at qty 1 -> maxPrice 650. The guest step (same cart, Anonymous minimum 800) stays below too
User decision 2026-10-29 (C2d): minMaxQuantity 13 on product1 and product2: the spec raises both lines to updatedQuantity 13 and the storefront caps a line at the product's MaximumQuantity
